answer.book: A single printed Latin academic disputation (Elementa charitometriae, Heidelberg, 1686 jubilee dissertation, respondent Henricus Horchius, president Johann Ludwig Fabricius): a title page, two dedications, then the theses in order: Definitiones, Postulatum, Axioma, Propositiones I-VII with their corollaries, and the section Dimensiones gratiae with its subsections.
